model_inference.when_unconfigured: terminal chat / workspace turns fail inside the worker ('Model inference failed: Not logged in') — set CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (subscription OAuth), an ANTHROPIC_* key, VEXA_LLM_API_KEY (completion adapters), or HOST_CLAUDE_CREDENTIALS (docker subscription mount)
